summary: Both inequalities are numerical: after the reduction to j = ⊤ (D = 𝖽, min(ϱ, ⊤) = ϱ), the first follows from τ⁴⁴𝖽₁ ≤ 𝖽 and the bound b^{11n³} for the leading minors of a near term; the second is the logarithm of the bound on the packet constant, packetConst ≤ (1+b⁻⁹)𝖽·deg·c_G^f/vol(Ô)^n·(ν·frameScaleProd/#BesselCoord)², combined linearly with the size inequalities.

steps.claim: Introduce the elementary size facts (2 ≤ g, 2 ≤ τ, 1000 ≤ b, 0 ≤ 𝖽₁, 0 ≤ 𝖽, 0 < N, 0 < ν, …).

Collect the inputs: 10⁵ ≤ ϱ (as ϱ = 10⁵ + e), 1 ≤ b, the packet-constant bound m of IsAdmissible, N ≤ b^{60n}, (200fk·rd_E)^{1000} ≤ b, 1000(2ϱ+2)⁹ ≤ k, 2 ≤ τ, 1 ≤ ∏_v |κ_v| (as each |κ_v| ≥ 1), κ nonempty, deg > 0, mass > 0, rd_E > 0 and c_G > 0.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨_, e⟩, b, m, Q, q, h, t, K⟩ := S.ϱ_le.dest, S.one_le_b, ok.packetConst_mul_mass_le,
    S.N_le, S.size_le, S.pow_le_k, ‹2 ≤ S.tailScale›,
    univ.one_le_prod₀ fun v _ ↦ S.one_le_abs_kappa v, Nonempty.intro 𝔰.k₀,
    S.besselDegree_pos, mass_pos E 𝔰.r, rootDiscr_pos E, 𝔰.openCellConst_pos

steps.claim: Unfold classSize at j = ⊤: since ϱ < ⊤ the numerator is 𝖽 and min(ϱ, ⊤) = ϱ; unfold termDiscNorm and frameScaleProd. Split the conjunction.
steps.lean: rw [classSize, termDiscNorm, frameScaleProd, ite_eq_left, min_eq_left] at *; constructor

steps.claim: First claim, b^{−k³f} ≤ τ²√(𝖽/(M g^{2ϱkf} x^{k+1})): bound M = countWeight(S, 0) and 𝖽 from below by τ⁴⁴𝖽₁ (besselEnergy_le), use g ≤ b²³, N ≥ 1, τ ≥ 2, and at each v |Φ_v(𝗀(γ))| ≤ |Φ_v(D_{ϱ+1})|² ≤ b^{11n³} (a near term, norm_map_leadingMinor_le, with 𝗀 = |D_{ϱ+1}|² − N²|D_ϱ|²), and #BesselCoord ≥ 1; then pass to the square root.
steps.lean:
grw [countWeight, ← ok.besselEnergy_le, besselEnergy, columnDim, g_le_b_pow, ← S.N_prime.one_le,
    ← t, ← one_le_two, one_pow, ← t, ← one_le_two, fun v ↦ ((n.norm_map_leadingMinor_le ⊤ v).trans'
    (by simp [↓← Complex.real_le_real, ↓← map_termDisc_eq_norm, frameDisc,
    RCLike.mul_conj]; bound) : ‖Φ v (S.termDisc γ)‖ ≤
    _), one_mul, ← @NeZero.one_le (Fintype.card S.BesselCoord), ← le_sqrt_of_sq_le]

steps.claim: The remaining inequality between powers of b holds since k ≥ 1000(2ϱ+2)⁹ (exponent comparison, linear arithmetic).
steps.lean: simp [field, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]; gcongr; exact h.dest.choose_spec ▸ by lia

steps.claim: Second claim: unfold cellMass, 𝖽, the Bessel degree, the real frame discriminant of γ_∞ at v (= (∏_a κ_v^{2(ϱ−a)}/N)²·|Φ_v(𝗀(γ))|) and the frame scales.
steps.lean:
simp_rw [cellMass, mainEnergy, besselDegree, gramDiscReal_realFrameGram_ratToInf, frameScaleSq,
    ← pow_abs_two_mul (kappa ..), add_comm 𝔰.k, pow_add] at *

steps.claim: In the packet-constant bound m, unfold packetConst, unipOrder and siegelConst and weaken it with 2 ≤ π, (k−1)! ≤ k^k, b ≥ 1, N ≥ 1 and |κ_v| ≤ b²³.
steps.lean:
grw [packetConst, unipOrder, siegelConst, ← two_le_pi, tsub_le_self, Nat.factorial_le_pow, ← b,
    ← S.N_prime.one_le, abs_kappa_le, tsub_le_self, tsub_le_self] at m; set g := S.g

steps.claim: Take logarithms of all quantities (all positive): the goal and m become linear inequalities in log b, log N, log τ, log g, log rd_E, log mass, log c_G and the log |Φ_v(𝗀(γ))|.
steps.lean:
simp (disch := positivity) only [volÔ_eq, abs_discr_eq_rootDiscr_pow, prod_pow_eq_pow_sum _ _ |_|,
    boxSize, columnDim, tailScale, Finset.prod_div_distrib, prod_const, prod_mul_distrib, card_univ,
    prod_pow, Fintype.card_pi, Fintype.card_fin, ← Real.log_le_log_iff, log_mul, log_div,
    Real.log_pow, Real.log_inv, Real.log_rpow, log_sqrt, Real.log_one, push_cast] at *; rify at *

steps.claim: The logarithmic goal is a linear combination of m, 3·(τ ≥ 2), and f·((k+ϱ+½)·q + log b·h)/1000 + ϱ⁷·Q (q: the size bound for b, h: k ≥ 1000(2ϱ+2)⁹, Q: N ≤ b^{60n}); the remainder is nonnegative.
steps.lean:
linear_combination (norm := rw [← neg_nonneg, ← e]) m + 3 * t + ↑(numInfPlaces E) *
    (((𝔰.k + 𝔰.ϱ + 0.5) * q + Real.log S.b * h) / 1000 + 𝔰.ϱ ^ 7 * Q)

steps.claim: The remainder after normalisation is a nonnegative expression in b ≥ 1, x ≥ 1 and ∏|κ_v| ≥ 1.
steps.lean: clear * - b N K; ring_nf; positivity

steps.claim: Side goals: positivity of powers of b ≥ 1.
